title: Supply Chain Vulnerabilities May Worsen Critical Electrical Equipment Bottlenecks, Further Delaying the U.S. Ability to Power AI Energy Expansion
summary_en: Researchers examined how supply chain vulnerabilities could affect the equipment needed to power frontier artificial intelligence (AI) data centers and, in turn, the U.S. power system’s ability to meet AI demand by 2030.
title_cn: Supply Chain Vulnerabilities May Worsen Critical Electrical Equipment Bottlenecks, Further Delaying the U.S. Ability to Power AI Energy Expansion
